sullengard_mayor_1.m: Welcome to Sullengard, kid. Happy 20th beer celebration!
r: Do you know where Defy is?
We want to contribute gold coins for your financial loss.

sullengard_mayor_10.m: What's on your mind? I can see it in your eyes. You have questions.
r: I'm looking into the break-in and robbery at Zaccheria's shop and I am wondering if you saw or know anything about it?

sullengard_mayor_2.m: No. We still don't know where that traitor is. How can we ever sleep peacefully and live sufficiently with this tragic situation?

sullengard_mayor_20.m: I heard you are helping Zaccheria in tracking down who stole his inventory.
r: Yes. Hence my reason for asking you about it.

sullengard_mayor_3.m: But please talk to my fellow bootleg brewers. Maybe they know something.

sullengard_mayor_30.m: I wish I knew more, but I don't. Maybe ask around near the tavern?

sullengard_mayor_4.m: Finally, at least we can survive for a day with a beer and some bread.
r: I noticed that I'm running out of money. I'll be back.

sullengard_mayor_4a.m: I have no words to express my gratitude.
r: That's all of the coins we owe you and your people, Mayor Ale.

sullengard_mayor_4c.m: We appreciate it. Thank you, kid.

sullengard_mayor_4d.m: Small successes cometh before big ones.

sullengard_mayor_5.m: Thank you so much again, kid. You are just like your brother Andor. After we are done speaking, you really should speak with my assistant, Maddalena.
r: Of course, he is my brother.

sullengard_mayor_6.m: He is taller than you, of course, but you guys have a very similiar looking face. He is one of the most active members in your guild.

sullengard_mayor_7.m: He was considered as the helping hand of Sullengard during rough days. Not unlike this scenario.

sullengard_mayor_beer.m: What? I am afraid that I have no idea what you are asking.
r: Oh, but I am sure you do. [You lean in closer to the mayor] Just between us, we both know that you do know.

sullengard_mayor_beer_0.m: How can I be of service to you my friend?
r: Can you tell me about your 'business agreement' with your beer 'distributors'?
We want to contribute gold coins for your financial loss.
Farrik told me a little bit about your operation.
Well, I know that the Thieves guild is your 'distributor'.

sullengard_mayor_beer_100.m: Not so much selling it because that was easy. After all, we have the best product in Dhayavar. But the problem was getting to the other towns safely and with a fresh batch.

sullengard_mayor_beer_105.m: Then after Lord Geomyr came to power and more specifically, after he decided to lay down such an unjust tax upon our beer sales, we desperately needed a 'distributor'.
r: Oh, that makes sense to me. But why the Thieves guild?

sullengard_mayor_beer_110.m: The decision was easy. We had done plenty of business with them in the past and they never did us wrong. Plus, they have the skills and resources to discreetly distribute our beer without Feygard interference.
r: I can't argue with that logic.
But you are breaking the laws of Feygard. Aren't you afraid you will get caught?

sullengard_mayor_beer_115.m: Please keep this information to yourself.

sullengard_mayor_beer_120.m: Not as much as we fear not being able to make a living selling our beer. Plus, we have the support of the people of Nor City

sullengard_mayor_beer_20.m: Then that must mean that you are someone that they trust?
r: I guess you could say that.

sullengard_mayor_beer_35.m: But how can you prove it to me?...Uh, I know. You can deliver this letter for me. Here, take it to Kealwea and return to me afterwards.

sullengard_mayor_beer_50.m: I had one of my people follow you. After all, I wasn't sure that you could be trusted.
r: Oh, I see. Now do you trust me?
Now can you trust me to let me know more about the 'business agreement'

sullengard_mayor_beer_60.m: Yes. You have proven yourself to me.
r: Finally! Now start talking. I'm getting annoyed.

sullengard_mayor_beer_70.m: Pull-up a chair kid and listen to the facts.
r: Oh, no! Another long-winded story. OK, let's get this over with.

sullengard_mayor_beer_80.m: You see, this all started many years ago before Lord Geomyr grew into power. The Sullengard brewers have been perfecting their beer brewing for many years and selling it outside of town for almost as long.

sullengard_mayor_beer_90.m:
Well, yes they are when it comes to brewing the beer, but not so much when it comes to selling it.
Even before Lord Geomyr grew into power, the citizens of Sullengard always had a hard time selling their beer.

sullengard_mayor_beer_letter_not_deliver.m: I have my ways of knowing. After all, I am the mayor.

sullengard_mayor_letter_delivered.m: Thank you for delivering my letter to Kealwea.
r: We want to contribute gold coins for your financial loss.

sullengard_mayor_no_letter_delivered.m: Why have you not delivered my letter to Kealwea yet?
r: We want to contribute gold coins for your financial loss.

beer_bootlegging.50: Farrik told me that the beer is coming from Sullengard. I really should go there next.
beer_bootlegging.60: To earn his trust, Mayor Ale has asked that I deliver his letter to Kealwea, the Sullengard priest.
beer_bootlegging.70: I have done what Mayor Ale has asked of me as I have delivered his letter. I should now return to him.
beer_bootlegging.80: Mayor Ale has explained everything to me about the 'business agreement' with the Thieves guild. I should head back to the Foaming flask tavern and speak with the captain.
